chapter.verse: Tua nung ciangin a lian mahmah nalamdang khat vantungah ka mu hi. Gimna nam sagih a nei vantungmi sagihte ahi uh hi. Tua gimnate in a nunung bel gimna ahi uh hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, Pasian’ hehna tua gimna tawh a kicing hi.

Tua nung ciangin mei tawh kihel, limlang tuipi banga om ahi zongin, sahang tung, ama milim leh ama min nambat gimna pan suakta-in a zo mite in, Pasian’ gawsemte tawi-in tua limlang tuipi kiangah ding-in a om uh ahi zongin ka mu hi.
Tua mite in Pasian’ sila Moses’ la leh Tuuno’ la sa-in: “Vanglianpen Topa Pasian aw, Na bawlnate lianin, a lamdang mahmah hi! Mipawl khempeuhte’ Kumpipa aw, Na gamtatnate in a dikin, a man hi!

Topa aw, nang min kua in kihta lo, phat loin a om ding hiam? Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, Nang bek na siangtho a, Nangma dikna gamtatnate in a kilang zo ahih ciangin Mipawl khempeuh in na mai-ah hong thuumin, hong bia ding uh hi,” ci-in a phat uh hi.
Tua thute khit ciangin vantungah teci tawh kipawl buk ahi, biakinnpi a kihong ka mu hi.
Gimna pawl sagih a nei vantungmi sagihte in a siangtho, a taang suangmanpha silhin, a awm-ah kham awmgak gakin tua biakinnpi pan a pusuah khit uh ciangin,
ganhing lite khat in vantungmi sagihte kiangah, a tawntung a nungta Pasian’ hehna tawh a dim kham hai sagih a pia hi.
Tua lai takin biakinnpi in Pasian’ vangliatna hangin meikhu tawh dimin, tua vantungmi sagihte’ gimna sagih a bei matengin biakinnpi sungah kuamah a lut thei kei ding hi.
